caption:
One verse on honesty and the company you keep

Allah calls the believers to fear Him and to be with those who are truthful. Choose words that are true today, and people who help you stay that way.

Surah At-Tawba 9:119

Name one truthful friend who keeps you honest.

#honesty #truthfulness #surahtawbah #quranreels

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
